sentinelAuditCoreRuntime.role: Frozen detection engine v1.1.0 — MUST NOT change during campaign

verdictLabels.truePositive: TP_VULNERABLE — Sentinel alerts on vulnerable revision
verdictLabels.falseNegative: FN_VULNERABLE — Sentinel misses on vulnerable revision
verdictLabels.alertPatched: ALERT_PATCHED — Sentinel alerts on patched revision (false positive for this CVE)
verdictLabels.cleanPatched: CLEAN_PATCHED — Sentinel clean on patched revision (true negative for this CVE)

measurementGroups: code_vulnerabilities — Sentinel finds the defect in source
dependency_vulnerabilities — Sentinel flags the affected version

pilotAcceptanceGates: G1: All 50 manifest entries have advisory ID, vulnerable SHA, fix SHA, affected file paths
G2: All vulnerable-revision clones completed without code execution
G3: All patched-revision clones completed without code execution
G4: Sentinel Audit ran on all 50 vulnerable revisions producing routing/decisions.json
G5: Sentinel Audit ran on all 50 patched revisions producing routing/decisions.json
G6: PHASE5_RESULTS.jsonl contains 100 records (50 vulnerable + 50 patched)
G8: No frozen engine SHA changed between corpus build and final scan
notes: Engine freeze is absolute. If any engine must change, create a new experimental version and new campaign. Never overwrite Phase 1–4 artifacts.
